application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Removal of rear roof extensions and erection of a rear roof extension with juliet balcony and replacement of three front roof windows.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (101 Existing, 102, 103, 104, 110 Front Elevation, 110 Rear Elevation, 101 Proposed, 102 Proposed, 203, 204, 210, 211: Received 21/03/2022. 
100: Received 09/05/2022. 
212: Received 22/07/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
